items.source: Used internally by CqlTemplate, but also useful for application code. Note that the passed-in PreparedStatement can have been created by the framework or by a custom PreparedStatementCreator. However, the latter is hardly ever necessary, as most custom callback actions will perform updates in which case a standard PreparedStatement is fine. Custom actions will always set parameter values themselves, so that PreparedStatementCreator capability is not needed either.
items.translation: 内部由 CqlTemplate 使用，但也适用于应用程序代码。请注意，传入的PreparedStatement可能是由框架创建或由自定义的PreparedStatementCreator创建的。然而，后者几乎从不必要，因为大多数自定义回调操作都会执行更新，此时标准的PreparedStatement即可满足需求。自定义操作总是会自行设置参数值，因此也不需要PreparedStatementCreator的功能。

items.source: Allows for returning a result object created within the callback, i.e. a domain object or a collection of domain objects. Note that there's special support for single step actions: see CqlTemplate.queryForObject(String, Class, Object...) etc. A thrown RuntimeException is treated as application exception, it gets propagated to the caller of the template.
items.translation: 允许返回在回调中创建的结果对象，即域对象或域对象的集合。请注意，单步操作具有特殊支持：参见CqlTemplate.queryForObject(String, Class, Object...)等方法。抛出的 RuntimeException 被视为应用程序异常，它将传播到模板的调用者。
